propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep spawns one git log --full-history walk per ticket inside the write lock, holding writers for minutes and causing 24+ minute stalls across the fleet

Per-ticket map misses fall through to per-event wildcard walks with leading-wildcard pathspecs that defeat pruning, making the deployed cost worse than per-ticket and equivalent to the bug 7084 per-event pathology
The sweep never re-yields mid-run: it probes write_lock_is_busy once before starting then loops over tickets without re-probing, so writers arriving after start time wait for the full sweep
The sweep stages changes with unscoped git add -A, allowing concurrent writers' in-flight event files to be swept into the compaction commit rather than remaining live for the next pass
A blocked writer sees only a bare pid in flock error output with no indication the holder is optional housekeeping that is safe to interrupt
